pkg_01_indian_constitution_art21.topic: Article 21: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty
pkg_01_indian_constitution_art21.declared_objective: Analyze how the Supreme Court's interpretation of 'procedure established by law' in Article 21 transformed from the literalist, formalistic reading in A.K. Gopalan (1950) into a substantive fairness requirement under the Golden Triangle doctrine in Maneka Gandhi (1978).

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Text of Art 21 and fundamental right status must be formally recognized.

MEANING.rationale: Core definition of life and personal liberty, contrasting biological existence with dignified life.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Structural mechanism of 'procedure established by law' vs American 'due process'.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Golden Triangle doctrine: mutual interrelation between Articles 14, 19, and 21.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Constitutional necessity of preventing executive/legislative arbitrariness.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Case-law analysis of Gopalan and Maneka Gandhi applications.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Valid statutory limits and lawful state deprivation procedures.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Modern digital privacy (Puttaswamy) is future context, not mandatory for historical evolution.

pkg_02_linear_algebra_eigenvalues.topic: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors of Linear Operators
pkg_02_linear_algebra_eigenvalues.declared_objective: Compute the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 2x2 matrix, explain the geometric intuition of an eigenvector as an invariant direction under linear transformation, and solve the characteristic polynomial det(A - lambda I) = 0.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Eigenvalue equation Ax = lambda x definition and terms.

MEANING.rationale: Geometric intuition of eigenvectors as invariant transformation directions.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Characteristic polynomial det(A - lambda I) = 0 and trace/determinant properties.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Singular matrix requirement for non-trivial nullspace vectors.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Why det = 0 yields eigenvalues and why non-zero eigenvectors exist.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Worked computation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors for 2x2 matrix.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Rotations with no real eigenvalues and defective matrix introduction.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Diagonalization A = S Lambda S^-1 is subsequent topic.

pkg_03_dsa_bfs_conceptual.declared_objective: Explain the conceptual mechanics of Breadth-First Search, prove why a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) queue guarantees level-order discovery and unweighted shortest-path traversal, and explain the invariant function of the visited set.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: BFS definition and FIFO queue identification.

MEANING.rationale: Level-order expansion and concentric ripple traversal intuition.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: FIFO queue data structure, visited boolean array, and adjacency list.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Queue FIFO invariant guaranteeing non-decreasing distance ordering.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Why visited set is necessary (cycle prevention) and why queue guarantees shortest path.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Conceptual graph trace; complete syntactic code is not required for conceptual objective.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Disconnected graph behavior mentioned briefly; not required for core traversal.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Bipartite graph coloring or advanced search out of scope.

pkg_04_dsa_bfs_implementation.declared_objective: Implement Breadth-First Search using a concrete queue data structure in code, trace variable states during execution, and implement robust edge-case handling for cyclic graphs and disconnected components.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: BFS and Queue data structure naming.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Queue STL/class methods (push, pop, front, empty) and visited tracking arrays.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Loop condition while(!q.empty()), dequeuing, neighbor iteration, enqueueing unvisited.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Why enqueuing without marking visited causes exponential redundant work.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Concrete variable-level code/pseudocode trace with memory and time analysis.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Explicit handling of cyclic graphs and disconnected components via outer loop.

pkg_05_deep_learning_vaes.declared_objective: Explain why classical autoencoders fail at smooth generative interpolation, derive the variational autoencoder objective mapping inputs to Gaussian distributions (mu, sigma^2), and justify the role of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence in regularizing the latent space.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Autoencoders, latent space, and Variational Autoencoders identification.

MEANING.rationale: Continuous probabilistic latent space vs discrete deterministic point bottleneck.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Probabilistic encoder predicting mean (mu) and variance (sigma^2), and decoder.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Dual-loss mechanism: reconstruction loss combined with KL divergence penalty.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Why standard autoencoders fail to generate novel samples and why KL prevents latent gaps.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Tracing latent distributions for Gaussian regularization.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Dimensionality flattening failure in FC autoencoders; blurry outputs.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Reparameterization trick details for backprop through stochastic node.

pkg_06_economics_elasticity.topic: Price Elasticity of Demand and Market Welfare
pkg_06_economics_elasticity.declared_objective: Calculate the price elasticity of demand using the midpoint method, interpret whether demand is price-elastic, inelastic, or unit-elastic, explain the relationship between elasticity and total revenue, and evaluate how price distortions create deadweight loss.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Definition of price elasticity of demand Ed and law of demand.

MEANING.rationale: Elasticity as quantitative responsiveness of quantity demanded to price changes.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Percentage change formula and midpoint formula structure.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Total revenue test: interplay between price effect and quantity effect across elastic/inelastic regimes.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Why percentages resolve unit dependency; why midpoint resolves direction dependency.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Numerical calculation of Ed using midpoint method and classification (|Ed| > 1, < 1, = 1).

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Welfare deadweight loss resulting from price ceilings restricting mutually beneficial trades.
